title: Interior product of a unit simple (m+1)-vector with a unit vector of its plane (Simon Ch. 6, 4.3)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, τ : Fin (m+1) → ℝ^P orthonormal, g ∈ span(range τ) with g ≠ 0, and w an (m+1)-vector with w = simpleNVector τ or w = −simpleNVector τ. Put ν := |g|⁻¹g and let w⌞ν := w ∘ ι(ν) be the m-vector α ↦ w(ν♭∧α), where ι(ν) := (alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ ℝ^P ℝ) ∘ (smulRightL ℝ ℝ^P Λ^m (innerSL ℝ ν)), i.e. (ν♭∧α)(v₀,…,v_m) = Σ_i (−1)^i ⟨ν, v_i⟩ α(v₀,…,v̂_i,…,v_m). Then there is an orthonormal τ′ : Fin m → ℝ^P with span(range τ′) = span(range τ) ∩ g^⊥ (= span(range τ) ⊓ (ℝ∙g)ᗮ) and w⌞ν = simpleNVector τ′ or w⌞ν = −simpleNVector τ′.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (τ : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl P) (g : Eucl P) (w : NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), Orthonormal ℝ τ → g ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (range τ) → g ≠ 0 → (w = simpleNVector τ ∨ w = -simpleNVector τ) → ∃ τ' : Fin m → Eucl P, Orthonormal ℝ τ' ∧ Submodule.span ℝ (range τ') = Submodule.span ℝ (range τ) ⊓ (ℝ ∙ g)ᗮ ∧ (w.comp ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖g‖⁻¹ • g)))) = simpleNVector τ' ∨ w.comp ((ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinCLM ℝ (Eucl P) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (Eucl P) (Covector (Eucl P) m) (innerSL ℝ (‖g‖⁻¹ • g)))) = -simpleNVector τ')
